The Toyota Innova Hycross just got its first major mid-lifecycle update and it brings a massive shift for India’s hybrid market. Along with subtle exterior tweaks and larger screens inside, the 2026 Innova Hycross is now India’s first strong-hybrid flex-fuel vehicle, capable of running on anywhere from E20 up to E85 (85% ethanol, 15% petrol).
Powertrain: 2.0-litre 4-cylinder Strong Hybrid (E20 to E85 compliant) + e-CVT
• ⁠ ⁠Output: 197 hp combined system output
• ⁠ ⁠Claimed Mileage: 22.58 kmpl (on E20 fuel)
